Welcome

Meet April, your AL and GA realtor

April Johnson is a REALTOR® with 1st Class Real Estate Excellence, a U.S. Army veteran and a Military Relocation Professional. She guides buyers and sellers across Columbus, Phenix City and East Alabama, many of them taking their first step into homeownership.

Her mission: to make buying and selling clear, calm and personal. Questions are welcome, worries are taken seriously, and every decision is explained before you make it.

A master’s degree in Acquisition Management shapes how she negotiates. An eye for interior design shapes how she helps sellers present a home.
